founder.label: Founder's Perspective
founder.quote: Art without strategy is decoration. Strategy without art is noise. We exist in the space between — and that space is where influence lives.
founder.bio: Ariana Moradi is a creative director and brand strategist with 12 years of experience shaping brands at the intersection of art and commerce. She founded FORMA to pursue a singular vision: creating work that matters.
founder.name: Ariana Moradi
founder.title: Founder & Creative Director

article1.title: Why the Most Successful Brands Behave Like Artists
article1.excerpt: The best brands don't follow trends—they create them. We explore how companies like Apple and luxury houses like Hermès apply artistic principles to business.

article2.title: The Psychology of Attention: What Advertising Can Learn from Gallery Design
article2.excerpt: Museums are masters of spatial storytelling. What can ad campaigns and brand experiences learn from how galleries direct the human eye?

article3.title: Restraint as a Creative Strategy: The Case for Saying Less
article3.excerpt: In a world of noise and clutter, simplicity and restraint have become radical acts. Why the most powerful messages often say the least.
